title: P18-A canonical objective_relation — the coordination layer's atomic fact between objectives in one business
description: P18-A: canonical objective_relation entity + ObjectiveRelationService — the substrate portfolio/parallel/handoff/duties/recovery consume. Closed kind vocabulary (DEPENDS_ON — downstream depends on upstream, CONFLICTS — contention, SUPERSEDES — lineage); state ACTIVE→SUSPENDED⇄ACTIVE→REVOKED (terminal, idempotent). Authority bilateral: actor = operator:<ref> must equal owner_authority_id of BOTH endpoints (different owners fail closed — bilateral consent deferred, not bypassed). business_id derived from canonical objectives (cross-business pairing impossible). DEPENDS_ON acyclicity proven at mint AND at RESUME over non-REVOKED edges (SUSPENDED edges stay in the graph — reviving never reopens a cycle). Idempotent mint per (from,to,kind) non-terminal; dedup check runs AFTER authority (no existence oracle). Digest pins all canonical fields (updated_at excluded); OCC on column version; CREATED/STATE event anchors. Reads (relationsFor/relationsForBusiness/upstreamOf/conflictsWith) re-prove exactly like writes: digest + entity binding + objective-business consistency + newest lifecycle event must agree with state — digest-recomputed flips, event-less forges, foreign pairings never served (P16-E re-proof pattern). P18-A boundary: minting is inert — no admission gate, scheduling effect, or UI; canonical metadata later seams consume. Codex-only; advisory/admission surfaces unchanged.
